A huge thank you to Annie Farmer, a courageous survivor of Jeffrey Epstein, who joined me for a conversation tonight with women across our local community. 

We're never going to stop fighting for justice.

There are now reports that Secretary Hegseth may have been trying to enrich himself by trading stocks related to defense companies leading up to the Iran War.

We’re launching an investigation today into what appears to be both major corruption and a national security threat.

Video

Trans people exist across our country, and they deserve dignity, kindness, and respect.

This Trans Day of Visibility, we must reaffirm that trans rights are human rights and all people deserve to live freely.

Epstein’s private investigators have been holding hard drives with critical evidence on them for decades. We’ve made it very clear that we want access to that data, and soon.

The cover-up stops now.

Video

Last night, Speaker Mike Johnson recessed Congress and sent everyone home after rejecting a bipartisan deal to fund DHS. Republicans and Democrats in the Senate did the right thing, and it’s crazy to reject the deal and recess Congress.

We've just confirmed that Epstein's lawyers hired private investigators to remove potentially critical evidence from his Florida mansion.

Oversight Democrats are demanding access to these hard drives and files, especially if they provide insight into Epstein's crimes.

Video

Epstein’s lawyers hired private investigators to remove evidence from his Palm Beach mansion.

This is significant information that hasn’t been accessible to the Congress or the public, and we want to know why.

Video

Donald Trump promised to lower costs "on day one." Instead, prices keep going up.

He needs to stop betraying the American people and end his war in Iran.

Video

In the case of Arnoldo, agents beat him, called him names, and pawned his cell phone. Yet there is no evidence that those agents have been removed or investigated.

In some cases, ICE and CBP agents have even been REWARDED for their horrific actions. Where is the accountability?

Video

For years, U.S. sanctions against Cuba has destroyed the economy and starved and killed innocent civilians. These sanctions are used to punish the regime but instead have hurt the poor and sick. We need a new foreign policy that actually centers the Cuban people.

Arnoldo Bazan was getting breakfast with his dad at McDonald's when masked agents brutally attacked them. Arnoldo—who's only in tenth grade—was choked, demeaned, and even had to go to the hospital.

What happened to him and so many others is horrific, and it has to end.

Video
We just filed for re-election to Congress!
Abolish ICE. #congressman #democrats #dems #abolishice
It’s a White House Cover-Up. #democrats #congressman #dems #oversightcommittee #releasethefiles
ICE is terrorizing LA. All people have a right to due process. #democrats #congressman #dems
NO MORE OIL DRILLING off our coast. #democrats #congressman #dems
We won’t stop until we RELEASE the Epstein files! #democrats #congressman
Time to stop this Epstein cover-up.
Release the Epstein Files, NOW. #democrats #congressman #dems
Let’s fucking go.
Let’s stop Trump and Vote!
